rule: line amounts, VAT per rate rounded once, totals, payment terms and Skonto, the save's limits, the e-invoice's amounts, typed euro amounts, a Stornorechnung's negated amounts

exempt.lib/invoices/actions.ts: Server Actions: parse, authorize and save; amounts come from amounts.ts.
exempt.lib/invoices/cancel-actions.ts: Server Action: authorize, check and cancel; the Storno's amounts come from cancel-model.ts, its number from cancel_invoice.
exempt.lib/invoices/issue-actions.ts: Server Actions: authorize, check and issue; amounts come from issue-model.ts and the invoice core, numbers from issue_invoice.
exempt.lib/invoices/issue-sources.ts: Reads the issue snapshot and lists the details still missing; it computes no amount.
exempt.lib/invoices/line-source-actions.ts: Server Action that reads a catalog line; it copies the price E1's and E2a's readers return and computes no amount.
exempt.lib/invoices/line-sources.ts: Types, schemas and the label of a line's catalog source.
exempt.lib/invoices/list-page.ts: Search and page parameters of the invoice list.
exempt.lib/invoices/original.ts: Renders, stores and files the original under a checked number; its amounts come from issue-model.ts and the invoice core, and the database assigns the number (invoice_issue.sql, invoice_issue_concurrency.sql).
exempt.lib/invoices/reads.ts: Server reader of stored drafts; it computes no amount.
exempt.lib/invoices/settings-actions.ts: Server Action: authorize and save; the limits live in settings.ts.
exempt.lib/invoices/settings-reads.ts: Server reader of the settings; the database formats the numbers.
exempt.lib/invoices/types.ts: Types, status labels and the allowed VAT rates.
exempt.lib/invoicing/check-en16931.ts: Runs the vendored CEN EN 16931 rules on the XML; it computes no amount.
exempt.lib/invoicing/embedded-xml.ts: Reads the XML back out of a PDF/A-3; it computes no amount.
exempt.lib/invoicing/fixtures/reference-invoice: Test fixtures; the property tests draw their parties from it.
exempt.lib/invoicing/model.ts: Types of the invoice model only.
exempt.lib/invoicing/rules/compile.ts: Build script that compiles the CEN rule stylesheet.
exempt.lib/invoicing/rules/manifest.ts: Hashes of the compiled CEN rules.
exempt.lib/invoicing/sample-invoice.ts: The fixed Musterrechnung; its amounts come from calculate.ts.
exempt.lib/invoicing/xml-text.ts: Tells whether a text can stand in the invoice XML; it computes no amount.
